blind.description: A detailed antique desk inkstand consisting of a rectangular brass or gold tray resting on four small ball feet. Inside the tray is a red velvet-lined surface holding a white ceramic ink jar with a domed brass lid, a small cylindrical brass pounce pot with a perforated top, and a white/beige quill pen lying horizontally across the front pen rest.
blind.from_above: A small rectangular brass tray with a red lining, containing two circular objects side-by-side at the top (a white jar with brass finial and a gold container) and a horizontal feather quill resting across the bottom.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/20th the height of the figure (around 3 to 4 inches tall) and less than 1/10th its width.

notes: Observer noted confidence 0.4 at table distance due to small prop scale, but correctly identified inkstand, inkwell, and quill
